interface.title: Tachisto builder
interface.field: Experimental psychology / cognitive science (online behavioural experiments with jsPsych)
interface.stage_of_work: Designing and building the study before data collection, then getting it ready to deploy
interface.what_it_is_for: Build a jsPsych reaction-time or questionnaire experiment without writing code (timeline, conditions tables, stimuli, loops and branches), watch it run live, and export runnable jsPsych source as one HTML file or a zipped project.

data.note: I built a study from scratch first. Then I uploaded flanker.json and shapes.json through 'Open a project…', pasted a small JSON spec into 'Open a spec someone sent…', and opened the built-in Stroop example card. I pasted an extra conditions table as CSV. Downloads I got: untitled-experiment.zip, untitled-experiment.html (886 KB, with jsPsych 8.3.0 and its plugins bundled in), untitled-experiment-flow.svg and shapes-demo-block-shape_trials.png.

tree.specific: Assemble a jsPsych experiment in Tachisto, preview it in the sandboxed frame, set up data handling and export the HTML or zip

edit cells, add a column such as the correct key

screens_never_reached: The guided tour ('New here? Take a one-minute tour' / Take the tour): I did not open it.
Dark and light appearance modes from the ⋯ menu: I did not switch them.
Split, Counterbalance and End step editors: these appear in the Add step menu, but I did not add them. I saw Checkpoint only in the Stroop example's flow (screens/053.webp).
The 'Ending early' section of the Study tab: it is visible in screens/021.webp but I did not change any of its settings.
Rendered screen pictures in Figures: I pressed 'Show the screens'. It showed 'Picturing the screens…' and the figure kept its placeholder boxes in my screenshots.

Finished downloads on screen: the zip, HTML and PNG files appear only in the browser's download list; no kept screen shows a completed download (screens/023.webp, 024.webp and 052.webp show the buttons or progress only).
A runtime repeat of the flanker practice loop: I did not finish all 8 practice trials, so I never saw the loop run again.
not_done: Adding my own image, sound or video files through 'add images, sounds or video': the only test files are JSON specs.
Filling the 'correct' column of my from-scratch Stroop table: the cells failed to fill because the grid redrew, so the column stayed empty (screens/011.webp).

Scoring the from-scratch Stroop block correctly: I scored against 'ink' (red/green) while the keys were r,g, so every trial would score incorrect; a column of r/g key values was needed and could not be filled (screens/012.webp).
Clearing the rich-text stimulus with Control+A: it did not select anything, so my text was appended. I fixed it in HTML mode.
Real DataPipe upload and Prolific redirect: these need external endpoints. I only filled in the settings and checked the generated code (screens/021.webp).
Testing the exported HTML or zip in a real browser: I read the start of the HTML file (bundled jsPsych 8.3.0, extension-pipe and plugins), but nothing beyond that.
Using the stroop.json test file through 'Open a project…': I opened the bundled Stroop example card instead.
